triangle \coloneqq (n : \mathbb{N}) \mapsto \sum_{i = 0}^{n} i
\forall n : \mathbb{N},\ n > 2 \land 2 \mid n \implies \exists p : \mathbb{N},\ \exists q : \mathbb{N},\ \operatorname{Prime}(p) \land \operatorname{Prime}(q) \land p + q = n
\forall n : \mathbb{N},\ \operatorname{Prime}(n^{2} + n + 41)
\forall n : \mathbb{N},\ 2 \cdot T_{n} = n \cdot (n + 1)
\forall n : \mathbb{N},\ \exists p : \mathbb{N},\ p \ge n \land \operatorname{Prime}(p)
\text{Goldbach's conjecture} \implies \exists p : \mathbb{N},\ \exists q : \mathbb{N},\ \operatorname{Prime}(p) \land \operatorname{Prime}(q) \land p + q = 100
\forall a, b : \mathbb{N},\ \gcd(a, b) \cdot \operatorname{lcm}(a, b) = a \cdot b
\forall a, b : \mathbb{N},\ \min(a, b) + \max(a, b) = a + b
\forall x, y : \mathbb{R},\ \left|x + y\right| \le \left|x\right| + \left|y\right|
\forall x, y : \mathbb{R},\ x \ge 0 \implies \sqrt{x \cdot y} = \sqrt{x} \cdot \sqrt{y}
\forall m, n : \mathbb{N},\ m > 0 \land m \le n \implies m \mid n!
\forall n, k : \mathbb{N},\ \binom{n + 1}{k + 1} = \binom{n}{k} + \binom{n}{k + 1}
\forall n : \mathbb{N},\ \sum_{i = 0}^{n - 1} (2 \cdot i + 1) = n^{2}
\forall n : \mathbb{N},\ \prod_{i = 0}^{n - 1} (i + 1) = n!
\forall x, y : \mathbb{R},\ \exp(x + y) = \exp(x) \cdot \exp(y)
\forall x : \mathbb{R},\ \sin(x)^{2} + \cos(x)^{2} = 1
\cos(\pi) = - 1
